(2) The man leans forward, gesturing with his right hand toward the collection of figures. He then holds up a teal-colored box with purple and orange graphics featuring the word 'Fuggler'. (3) The man begins opening small boxes. He pulls out an orange figure with a round body and flowery underwear. He holds it up for a close-up, showing its silver keychain ring. (4) He places the orange figure on the table and picks up another box. He extracts a purple figure with small ears and large teeth. The camera cuts to a close-up of the figure on the table next to an orange and blue one. (5) A teal and white striped figure with a long red tongue and pink button eyes is shown in an extreme close-up. (6) The man holds up a bright pink cat-like figure with white fur on its chest and googly eyes. He dangles it from its silver keychain. (7) He opens a box to reveal a light blue bat-like figure with purple wings and pink button eyes. He looks surprised and excited, holding it close to the lens. (8) The man stands up, wearing dark pinstriped trousers with a brown belt. He has several of the colorful keychains hanging from his belt loops. He gestures toward his waist and then points toward the camera with a grin.
